t: This is The Wabe, an architecturally eclectic detached house on Redington Road in Hampstead, built in 1902 and 1903. It was built for William Garnett, an academic and mathematician with a special interest in electric street lighting. Later it was home to the Canadian explorer Mina Hubbard, who in 1905 first accurately mapped the Nascaupee and George River system in Labrador. Afterwards the actor Tom Conti lived here with his wife, and his daughter Nina, the actress and ventriloquist, is listed as living here from 1985.
